decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building in particular and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations)

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 59 St. Stephen's Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).

Condition : 6 - The proposed extensions and outbuilding, by reason of their scale, siting, design  and appearance would be in keeping with and sympathetic to the character of the existing house, and the pattern of development in the area, and would not cause harm to neighbours living conditions through shading and/or loss of outlook. The proposal would thereby preserve or enhance the St Stephen's Conservation Area and the living conditions of its occupants, in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and roof extension to house and detached single storey shed to rear
